verdict.rationale: incident.io ships multiple AI-generated insight features embedded directly in the product: AI-generated post-mortem drafts and review suggestions, suggested summaries, AI Suggestions that draft updates/summaries/follow-ups from incident activity, insights/analytics comparisons, and 'Investigations' which automatically gathers evidence, forms hypotheses, and surfaces root-cause findings across incident data. These are first-party documented in-product capabilities, not just an external chat interface. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of accuracy or reliability of these AI insights beyond vendor docs.
